entry.title: BIP 110: update status to closed
entry.summary: The proposal to mark BIP 110 as closed has been put forward due to the recent chain split that occurred during its mandatory signaling period. This incident resulted in the rejection of all blocks that failed to signal bit 4, leading to a halt in mining and block production on the BIP 110 chain. According to BIP 3, a Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) can transition from a Deployed status to Closed when it is no longer actively used. Closure of a BIP involves announcing the intention on a mailing list followed by a waiting period of four weeks where community members can raise objections. If no objections are made, the BIP is officially marked as Closed. It is important to note that even after closure, BIPs are not deleted but are kept for historical and educational purposes. This process ensures transparency and allows community involvement in the decision-making process regarding the lifecycle of each BIP.
